theme_central: "Arise and warn!" — the heart of the surah is this command that moves the Prophet from personal spirituality to public responsibility.

branches.title: Arise and warn
branches.resume: Direct command: rise, warn, purify yourself, be patient — preparation before the continuation of the revelation.

children.t: "Arise and warn!", purification and patience requested

branches.title: The wealthy opponent
branches.resume: Portrait of a Meccan notable (Al-Walid ibn al-Mughira) who deliberately rejects the truth despite all his advantages.

children.t: The wealthy opponent deliberately rejects the truth despite his advantages

branches.title: Saqar, the nineteen keepers
branches.resume: Hell (Saqar) described as a blaze; nineteen stern keepers, a trial for disbelievers and a confirmation for believers.

children.t: Saqar, nineteen stern keepers, a trial for hearts

branches.title: Oaths, dialogue in Hell
branches.resume: Oaths by the moon, the night, the dawn; dialogue with the criminals about what led them to Hell.

children.t: Oaths by the moon, the retreating night, the whitening dawn
Dialogue with the criminals: did not pray, did not feed the poor

branches.title: Closing
branches.resume: Why do they turn away like frightened donkeys? No one is reminded unless Allah wills it.

children.t: Fleeing like frightened donkeys; no reminder without Allah's will
